title: JANUS Cultural Mechanics — spiral audit of hidden structure and ontology leakage
purpose: Audit the apparent portable machines for deeper common structure, subset relations, classifier/ontology leakage, and self-similarity in the research procedure before any stronger universality claim.

verified_observations.observation: Every strict PM03 hit is also a strict PM04 hit in both evaluated receipts.
verified_observations.interpretation_boundary: This is an empirical relation on the current encoded corpora, not proof of universal set inclusion.

verified_observations.observation: The frozen ontology allows PM03-defining events to satisfy PM04 predicates: recurrence can count as structural revisit, accumulated knowledge/memory as memory-weight increase, and resolution/model update as global-model update.
verified_observations.consequence: PM03 and PM04 must not be counted as independent confirmations of each other under the current ontology.

verified_observations.observation: R3 PM05 positive cases B014-B016 also produced PM04 partial scores of 0.667; in R4 proxy all six PM05 strict cases H019-H024 also produced PM04 partial scores of 0.667.
verified_observations.consequence: Some PM05↔PM04 overlap is induced by the shared feature vocabulary and cannot be treated as independent narrative evidence.

verified_observations.observation: R4B blinds the independent encoder from PM01-PM05, classifier predicates, projection map and prior outcomes, but the neutral tag ontology itself was designed downstream of the machine-discovery process.
verified_observations.formal_boundary: ENCODER ⟂ CLASSIFIER does not imply FEATURES ⟂ HYPOTHESIS.

higher_order_hypotheses.claim_boundary: PM01 and PM02 may be modes of one higher-order divergence family; this is not yet independently classified.

higher_order_hypotheses.hierarchy: PM04 is a broad structural memory/revisit envelope; PM03 is a narrower agent-level recursion/self-model/feedback specialization.
higher_order_hypotheses.required_test: Use feature-blind encoding and synthetic separation controls to find PM04-without-PM03 and PM03 candidates whose PM04 score is not mechanically guaranteed.

higher_order_hypotheses.idea: A symbol or transferred object may import accumulated prior narrative weight without replaying the prior narrative, functioning as a compressed-history carrier.
higher_order_hypotheses.claim_boundary: Current overlap is partly ontology-induced; independent support is required.

higher_order_hypotheses.observation: The R2→R4B research process itself resembles PM03: repeated tests -> detection of failures/boundaries -> model update -> feedback into next experiment -> stabilize or break.
higher_order_hypotheses.firewall: Methodological self-similarity is not independent validation of PM03.

higher_order_hypotheses.interpretation: PM01-PM05 may be projections or specializations of a smaller set of higher-order information-processing motifs.

benefits: A hierarchy of mechanics instead of a flat list of five labels.
A way to prevent double-counting correlated machines as independent evidence.
A concrete explanation for some apparent transfer success as ontology leakage rather than narrative universality.
A candidate compression layer for future JANUS Mechanics Index: higher-order families -> specialized PMs.
A falsifiable path to distinguish sequence structure from bags of semantically suggestive tags.
A reusable audit principle for other JANUS branches: FEATURE DESIGN CAN LEAK THE HYPOTHESIS EVEN WHEN LABELS ARE BLINDED.
what_this_gives_janus.canonical_warning: A stronger abstraction is valuable only if it survives tests designed to destroy representation-induced overlap.

new_gate.classifier_policy: Do not modify the frozen R3 classifier for the preregistered R4B test.
r4c_components: Encode unseen works first as minimally interpreted raw event graphs using actor/action/object/time/causal-edge primitives rather than PM-derived semantic tags.
Freeze raw graph hashes before any semantic mapping.
Use a separate frozen mapper to convert raw events into the existing neutral ontology.
Run sequence-permutation controls that preserve nodes/tags but shuffle event order.
Run feature-permutation or decoy-ontology controls to estimate how much score comes from tag availability rather than causal order.
Measure conditional overlap PM03|PM04 and PM04|PM03 instead of counting both as independent wins.
Specifically test whether COMPRESSED_HISTORY_OPERATOR survives when symbolic-weight tags are not pre-encoded.
new_gate.key_order_test: score(real_order) must materially exceed score(shuffled_order) for a sequence machine to be credited as causal-order sensitive.
